verdict.rationale: Vercel provides a CLI (vercel-probe-4, vercel-gh-1) and REST/OpenAPI API (vercel-probe-3) that support scripted deploys and CI integration, plus git-push-to-deploy workflows (vercel-docs-1, vercel-gh-1) suitable for automation pipelines. However, there is no direct evidence of dedicated CI/headless-mode documentation, and community feedback raises concerns about opaque billing/security behavior that could complicate unattended automated use (vercel-comm-12, vercel-comm-11).
